27c592e0fd8bedf1e39b6f097e13184f6e12fbd6.notes: Rail connection/search tolerances and half-width in meters. minLinkDirDot is a tangent dot-product threshold (0.5 permits a 60-degree bend); next is an optional manual segment link. Centerline geometry is omitted.

2f9723cd9f05156fe6efdedfa8379aa84a95e67a.name: Bicycle_Generator_Seat_Model
2f9723cd9f05156fe6efdedfa8379aa84a95e67a.notes: Stationary generator-bike rotation defaults. Despite their names, wheelTorque/sprintWheelTorque drive an interpolated wheel rotation rate in degrees per second in Update. This subclass has an empty FixedUpdate and does not use the moving bicycle's propulsion settings. Fuel generation is implemented in Bicycle_Glue.Generate_Power.

54d27b9f223a69e790e93dcf955b0494e380a33a.notes: Maximum steering angle in degrees and owning vehicle binding. Input, running state and discovered tire instances are omitted.

74400d539fb114e7b29fcf7808275c91f5553ae9.name: Off-road_Bike
74400d539fb114e7b29fcf7808275c91f5553ae9.notes: Bicycle movement defaults and curve keys. topSpeed/reversingSpeed compare against rigidbody speed; relaxedSpeed is a multiplier. Friction vectors store static (x) and dynamic (y) coefficients. Acceleration curve input is acceleration control, steering curve input is speed, and lean curve input is lean control. Live input, recorded rides and animation geometry are omitted.
